name: Unexpected Number Neighbor
source:
Don't you hate it when an unknown number contacts you?

Would you feel the same if it was a hot hyper redhead?? Maybe you can respond this once... 

[From [url=https://moxigames.itch.io/unexpected-number-neighbor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
收到陌生号码发来的消息时，你是不是也觉得烦人透顶？

可如果对方是一位火辣又元气满满的红发美女呢？？或许就这一次，回条消息也无妨……

[摘自[url=https://moxigames.itch.io/unexpected-number-neighbor]itch.io[/url]]
